text:
sam: Quick ask 10min
Our prospect, PolarisEdge, wants us to start a 7-day POC on Monday but their vendor-risk team wants SOC 2 or a bridge letter + limited evidence access. Can we produce a bridge letter and presigned S3 links for scrubbed SOC2 excerpts by EOD tomorrow? Need legal + security approvals. cc @lee-legal @nina-sec

lee-legal: We can provide a short bridge letter stating the SOC 2 audit is ongoing and an estimated delivery month. I'll need: (1) exact filenames to expose, (2) confirmation NDA will be executed, (3) confirmation on IP restrictions and expiry. I can draft a bridge letter and an NDA addendum in ~2-3 hours.

nina-sec: Security can support a constrained evidence bundle exposed through presigned URLs with IP whitelisting and 48-72h TTL. Requirements: requester emails, source IPs (CIDR or single IP), and assurance files are redacted of customer PII and resource IDs. We'll cap total downloads to 250MB and require MD5 for each file. :lock:

tom-eng: Engineering will stage files under s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1937010000-polarisedge/ and generate presigned links once legal approves the list. We'll remove screenshots and any console dump. Example command we will use:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1937010000-polarisedge/controls_excerpt.csv --expires-in 172800
```
We'll also run a checksum and add proxy-based IP enforcement.

acct-lead: PolarisEdge prefers DocuSign. They also asked for the bridge letter to include the audit firm name and an approximate delivery month. They want a one-page access checklist for procurement.

lee-legal: Confirmed we can include auditor name subject to their consent; I'll check. Drafts uploaded to legal drive and linked. Bridge letter template will say: "SOC 2 audit in progress; expected delivery [month-year]; provided excerpts are redacted and preliminary; this letter is not the final report."

sam: Proposed process: 1) NDA signed -> 2) legal posts bridge letter -> 3) security signs off on file list and IPs -> 4) eng posts presigned URLs -> 5) acct-lead shares links with PolarisEdge. Everyone ok?

nina-sec: OK assuming NDA signs today. Please provide requester IPs and emails. We'll whitelist only those IPs, TTL 72h, 250MB cap.

tom-eng: Starting export to the staging path now. Approved artifact names proposed: controls_excerpt.csv, caiq_redacted.pdf, infra/redacted_infra.zip, logs/redacted_app_2026-02.tar.gz. No screenshots or raw exec logs.

deploy-bot: exporter-job queued -> image:evidence-exporter:1.4 -> build:4099 -> job_id=ev-8097

lee-legal: NDA + bridge letter ready on legal drive. I'm preparing a DocuSign envelope. Note: we require PolarisEdge to sign before links are issued. Bridge letter wording avoids warranty language.

acct-lead: Sending DocuSign now to PolarisEdge. Also requested the one-page checklist; sam can you draft that?

sam: Will draft the checklist (steps, IP whitelist, TTL, contact) and post here in ~25m. Target to have links out before EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: export finished -> staged 4 files under s3://redwood-poc-evidence/1937010000-polarisedge/ -> checksum ok

tom-eng: Files staged and checksums verified. Waiting for legal greenlight after DocuSign completes.

nina-sec: Whitelist confirmed for access: 198.51.100.88, 203.0.113.129. Requestor emails: james@polarisedge.com, secops@polarisedge.com. Approved.

lee-legal: DocuSign indicates PolarisEdge signed. I'm clearing the bridge letter for issuance and attaching auditor name per consent we received. Bridge letter + access instructions uploaded to legal drive.

tom-eng: Generating presigned URLs with 72h TTL and enforcing IP whitelist via proxy now. Will paste links to legal drive.

deploy-bot: presign-task -> created 4 links -> ttl=259200s -> ip-whitelist applied

tom-eng: Links generated and posted to legal drive. acct-lead, please confirm you will send them to PolarisEdge from your corporate email and remind them links only work from the whitelisted IPs.

acct-lead: Sent links and checklist to PolarisEdge. They confirmed access from 198.51.100.88 and can download. POC kickoff scheduled for Monday 09:00 PST. Thanks team.

lee-legal: Closing intake. Remember to store NDA and bridge letter in contract repo and mark the evidence staging path for deletion after TTL expires and per retention policy.

sam: Great job everyone closing thread.
